course_description: IoT Architecture & Embedded Systems is a course that teaches you how smart, connected devices are designed and built — from the tiny microcontrollers and sensors that sense the physical world, to the wireless networks and cloud platforms that bring their data to life. You'll learn how hardware and software come together to create intelligent systems like smart homes, wearables, and industrial monitors, while also understanding the communication protocols, power constraints, and security practices that make real-world IoT solutions reliable and efficient.
